newsitem.title: CANADA: WCE canola ends down on commission sell stops.
newsitem.headline: WCE canola ends down on commission sell stops.

text.p: WCE canola futures ended down on commission sell stops and local sales, traders said.

"There were some commission stop loss sell orders, Cargill bought 400 March and sold soybeans," a trader said. Jan-Mar spread at $2.50, Jan-July $4.50. January futures crush profit margin fell to -35.88 from -35.29 on Monday. Volume was 3,625 lots, or 72,500 tonnes, with 225 hedge lots.
January canola fell $0.80 to $396, March lost $1.70 to $398. March flax lost $1 to $348. Jan-Mar spread at $4, Jan July $10.
Peas and oats did not trade.
February western barley was unchanged at $134.50, May fell $0.30 to $133.70 as 300 Feb-May spread at $0.70. Volume was 600 lots.
March feed wheat fell $0.50 to $165.50 as LFG was the featured seller. Volume was 220 lots.
The markets will be closed Wednesday for the New Year's holiday.
(All values in Canadian dollars/tonne except peas, oats)
